task: Core #1186 U10B Digital Office admin navigation and Alap support access

assuranceCeiling.rationale: This is a bounded Core #1186 admin-navigation and safe merchant support-link correction, not completion of the wider package-entitlement issue. Security proof must establish that Alap cannot discover or navigate the Pro-only Digital Office while retaining safe independent support tickets, customer notifications and suppression management. Source plus full CI, exact-head governance, route and permission regressions cover this scope only; live tenant, provider and cross-workflow acceptance remain separate.

acceptanceCriteria: Alap entitlement navigation never exposes the Digital Office section or its direct Pro workspace link, even while the Alap customer-email capability remains enabled.
Pro continues to discover its Digital Office workspace, Team Chat and advanced correspondence according to existing server-authoritative feature and role gates.
Alap and Pro support tickets and ticket-detail back navigation use existing independent /admin/ugyfelszolgalat routes; ticket data remains scoped by tenant and support permission.

Customer-email suppression remains reachable from the Alap marketing navigation at a new independently server-gated URL; reuse the existing data-scoped suppression page and API without weakening them.

All static admin link integrity, entitlement and navigation regression checks succeed, followed by Knowledge, Edit-Time, Replay, full CI, Completion Truth and Lifecycle gates at the exact source commit.
invariants: Do not grant Alap access to any /admin/kommunikacio page or Digital Office staff workflow; the existing Pro-only layout remains server-owned.
Preserve Alap normal customer transactional email, support.manage staff ticket workflows, communication suppression and marketing basics.
Keep the existing canonical plan catalogue and entitlement resolver authoritative; no second product-package or RBAC engine is introduced.
No changes to database migrations, RLS, tenant plan rows, secrets, scheduled jobs or production deployment are permitted in U10B.
The existing /admin/kommunikacio/tiltolista and support alias routes remain available only within the original Pro shell for backwards compatibility.
forbiddenStates: An Alap merchant is invited into a Pro-only Digital Office menu item that redirects to upgrade or denies access.
A support ticket link sends an Alap user from an allowed support inbox into a Pro-only shell.
An Alap merchant loses existing customer-email suppression or support actions because the Pro workspace is hidden.
A marketing suppression page is rendered without the existing tenant and marketing permission checks.
The U10B navigation proof is reported as overall #1186 closure without independent production-like entitlement, worker and DB/RLS evidence.

failureModes: Shared Alap officeCommunication inadvertently appears as the Pro-only workspace feature in desktop or mobile admin navigation.
Support ticket links point into /admin/kommunikacio/ugyfelszolgalat and the Pro layout denies access to an otherwise authorized Alap support operator.
Relocating the suppression link makes the UI or API unreachable to Alap, leaving ordinary email safety controls inaccessible.
Removing an item from the Digital Office section unintentionally exposes its advanced server actions under a different route.
Entitlement-navigation resolver interprets a trial or a platform role as a cross-tenant Pro package grant.
New independent route forgets authorization and tenant scoping; the UI appears but fails or leaks data.
edgeCases: An Alap account has officeCommunication true and officeCommunicationAdvanced false, with marketing.manage and support.manage roles.
An Alap account has support permission but not marketing permission; ticket access remains allowed while suppression management remains hidden.
A Pro account has Team Chat disabled but advancedEmail enabled; Office remains discoverable without granting chat.
Legacy deep links into the Pro Digital Office should stay protected even though new Alap links use independent routes.
The document's exact base SHA changes after main merge and the Development Guard must reject stale plans.

alternatives.summary: Route basic Alap support and suppression through existing independent admin modules while filtering the Digital Office exclusively by the Pro entitlement.
alternatives.reason: Preserves a single canonical navigation catalogue and server permission chain while fixing both menu discovery and actual linked destinations.

alternatives.summary: Hide the Digitális Iroda label but retain its old ordinary-email feature and existing Pro-only support and suppression links.
alternatives.reason: Only masks the visible symptom; Alap users would still receive denied links and lose existing safe customer operations.

alternatives.summary: Permit Alap to enter part of /admin/kommunikacio by adding layout bypasses for support, email and suppression child routes.
alternatives.reason: Violates the accepted all-Pro Digital Office workspace boundary and risks indirect advanced workflow access.

specialistReviews.finding: The U10A merged authority identifies the shared admin navigation manifest as an existing admin-operations-owned file.
specialistReviews.resolution: Move canonical menu metadata only and reuse the existing support and suppression page implementations rather than a new office or entitlement system.

specialistReviews.finding: An Alap-safe menu that points to a Pro-only nested route is still a broken access path; simple visibility toggling is insufficient.
specialistReviews.resolution: Rewrite both support inbox and detail back-links to the independent tenant-scoped support route, and isolate suppression at a correctly gated independent URL.

specialistReviews.finding: An admin route and navigation change can affect all active packages even though it does not modify the plan catalogue or database.
specialistReviews.resolution: Use only the explicitly scoped admin and test paths with exact-base CI, source-bound Truth and closed Lifecycle evidence; avoid unrelated Builder/Factory work.

challenge.scenario: Alap merchant has enabled basic officeCommunication and clicks the canonical Digitális Iroda section.
challenge.finding: The current navigation advertises a Pro-only server page based on the wrong feature grant.
challenge.resolution: Bind the only Digital Office customer-email item to officeCommunicationAdvanced, and keep it outside Alap navigation.

challenge.scenario: Alap support operator opens a ticket in the allowed independent support inbox.
challenge.finding: The current ticket links jump under the Pro-only communication layout and block the basic support workflow.
challenge.resolution: Use the independent support ticket and detail route for all links, preserving existing tenant-scoped access.

challenge.scenario: Alap marketing manager needs to block an address after a delivery complaint.
challenge.finding: The existing suppression link is inside the Pro-only layout and is unreachable even with valid basic email privileges.
challenge.resolution: Create one independent feature- and tenant-gated suppression route reusing the existing view, then place its navigation under Marketing.

challenge.scenario: A Pro user has advanced email but an internal Team Chat suspension.
challenge.finding: Overly broad plan filtering could hide the permitted workspace or silently re-enable disabled chat.
challenge.resolution: Use the current per-feature entitlement and team capability gates without changing Team Chat behavior.

challenge.scenario: An Alap user guesses an old deep link to the legacy Digital Office aliases.
challenge.finding: A new independent route must not weaken the inherited Pro-only layout guard.
challenge.resolution: Keep original communication subtree and its requirePlanFeature officeCommunicationAdvanced unmodified.

challenge.scenario: A page link or back-link is updated without regression coverage for mobile and direct route navigation.
challenge.finding: The UI may appear correct for one entry path while another links into the old gated shell.
challenge.resolution: Extend static route integrity and package-specific navigation tests for support and suppression, with full CI and no waivers.

proofPlan: Verify the exact merged U10A main and its previous GREEN CI and Lifecycle before starting this new Core transaction.
Admit only the exact U10B file plan through Development Guard and Plan Before Code prior to any source implementation.
Exercise Alap and Pro feature-resolution matrices and assert direct digital-office URL is absent for Alap without disabling officeCommunication.
Check independent tenant-scoped support list and detail link paths and Alap suppression route against the existing safe API permission gate.
Run targeted navigation, admin-link, Pro-entitlement and support tests plus full Quality, TypeScript, build, Edit-Time/Reference Sync, Replay and exact-head Truth/Lifecycle.
Do not merge or claim all #1186 capabilities closed merely because U10B navigation and link paths pass.

requirements.requirement: Alap never discovers the Pro-only Digital Office workspace, while Pro retains existing feature/permission gates.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: An Alap user must not receive a navigable Digital Office workspace path based on ordinary email entitlement.

requirements.requirement: Existing independent support routes and Alap-safe communication suppression remain discoverable and permission-gated without duplicating their business logic.

forbiddenRegressions.statement: Support and suppression must not depend on the Pro-only Digital Office layout or bypass tenant authorization.

notes:
Scoped immediate successor to the merged U10A navigation-authority prerequisite, according to the Living Roadmap Core priority and accepted all-Pro Digital Office boundary. Alap normal email and support must survive. Previous #1186 U01-U09 changes are on main. No Builder, Template Factory, schema, tenant or payment modification. Only start product implementation after canonical plan-only gate PASS.
Plan Before Code first PR verification run 38209383695 resolved additional storefront-ui subsystem and two associated known-failure records due to src/app/admin/** files matching the shared src/app/** pattern. The canonical policy defines the added scope and risk; this plan now acknowledges it exactly before any implementation edits.
